name: J
bio: Archetype: Shielding, Counter, AoE DPT, HP Burn. ⌽ When inflicting [Burn], gain the same amount of [Burn]. ([Burn] damage stops when J is at 15% max HP). ⌽ S2 grants team-wide special shield that scales with self-[Burn]. With enough [Burn] this shield becomes very thick. ⌽ For each ally hit while under this special shield, ripostes with an AoE follow up attack. Less HP = more riposte damage. ⌽ Very strong when faced with multiple enemies with multiple AP and AoE attacks, but requires a strong sustain in such scenarios.
